items.premise: CI beacon watched only E2E, Accessibility, and Lighthouse and collapsed terminal failures into a generic summary.
A single global Lighthouse Performance floor did not distinguish lab-volatile homepage/catalog routes from stricter trust routes.
Remote CI cannot be confirmed green until the S270 commit lands and the new Lighthouse workflow runs.

honestyLedger.title: Homepage Lighthouse 0.85 not claimed
honestyLedger.why: Current Lighthouse evidence has homepage performance around 0.76; the route-tier gate enforces the observed floor and leaves stricter lab performance as a future trace-backed fix.

honestyLedger.title: Worker deploy remains token-scope gated
honestyLedger.why: The beacon classifies Deploy Cloudflare Worker as known_blocked on CF_WORKER_API_TOKEN R2 scope; it does not claim a code fix.
